A '''[[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]''' was distinguished by their [[Monkey/Legends|ape]]-like features, including sunken [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and prognathous [[Mouth/Legends|jaw]]. By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="EP1Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> at least four members of this species were members of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The species first appeared in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars:'' Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" />
